title: CommonTrace Graph Node
description: A node in the CommonTrace temporal property graph, representing an entity such as a service, tool, error, concept, lesson, scope, user, or file.

id.description: Unique node identifier, formatted with entity type prefix (e.g. 'service:billing', 'tool:jwt_validator', 'error:timeout').

entity_type.description: Classification category of the node entity.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the entity.

properties.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata and domain attributes associated with the entity.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when this node was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording the latest update to this node.
